skill.name: flux-kontext
skill.description: Use Flux 1 Kontext Pro on RunComfy for precise single-image edits. The skill provides model selection guidance, input schema details, and preservation-focused prompt patterns.
skill.summary: Create precise local image edits with Flux 1 Kontext Pro through RunComfy.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate external command, network, and credential-storage behavior because it relies on the RunComfy CLI and Model API. Most Markdown backtick, placeholder URL, and ellipsis findings are false positives, but the RunComfy command workflow, third-party processing, output downloads, and token file storage are real risks.

remediation.issue: Global CLI installation and command execution
remediation.suggestion: Pin the RunComfy CLI version, document expected commands, and require user confirmation before any install or model run.

remediation.issue: Third-party processing of prompts and images
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit confidential images or prompts unless their data policy allows RunComfy processing.

remediation.issue: RunComfy token stored in a hidden home-directory file
remediation.suggestion: Document token cleanup, least-privilege token use, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN option for ephemeral environments.

remediation.issue: Remote generated files are downloaded locally
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a dedicated output directory and tell users to inspect generated files before reusing them.

content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits can drift when prompts mix many changes or omit preservation details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Flux Kontext Pro through RunComfy with focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Routes explicit Flux Kontext requests to the RunComfy Flux 1 Kontext Pro edit endpoint.
Explains the required prompt and image inputs, plus optional aspect ratio and seed fields.
Provides RunComfy CLI examples for local edits and seeded variant runs.
Shows preservation-led prompt patterns for identity, product, label, and composition edits.
Compares when to use related image models instead of Flux Kontext.
limitations: Supports one source image per run; multi-image workflows need another model.
Requires RunComfy CLI access and a signed-in account or token.
Uses publicly fetchable image URLs for source images.
Complex multi-change prompts may drift and should be split into smaller edits.

use_cases.title: Retouch Product Labels
use_cases.description: Change label text or color while preserving product shape, lighting, and table placement.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Add one visual element to a source image while keeping the main subject recognizable.

use_cases.title: Build Agent Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Use a clear schema and model routing rules for repeatable single-image edits.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Local Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one simple change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro to edit this image: [image URL]. Keep the subject unchanged and add [one change]. Save the result to [output folder].

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Product Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate product image edit with strict preservation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this product image with Flux Kontext Pro. Keep the silhouette, lighting, table, and camera angle unchanged. Replace only [target detail] with [new detail].

prompt_templates.title: Seeded Variant Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced comparison of reproducible edit variants.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Flux Kontext Pro on [image URL] with seed [number]. Make this single change: [change]. Compare the result with one alternate seed.

prompt_templates.title: Model Selection and Execution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow that checks whether Flux Kontext is the right model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether Flux Kontext Pro is suitable for this edit: [goal]. If it is suitable, create a preservation-led prompt and run it through RunComfy.

output_examples.input: Edit a portrait so the person holds an orange umbrella and has a slight smile.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Flux Kontext Pro, preserves the face, pose, and clothing, adds the umbrella, and saves the generated image.

output_examples.input: Change a bottle label from ALPHA to AURA without changing the bottle or lighting.
output_examples.output: The assistant writes a preservation-first prompt, targets only the label text, and keeps the product scene stable.

output_examples.input: Make three unrelated changes across several reference images.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that Flux Kontext is not the best fit and recommends a multi-image or staged workflow.

best_practices: State what must remain unchanged before describing the edit.
Make one targeted change per run for stronger preservation.
Use a seed when comparing small variants or reproducing a result.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not use this skill for multi-reference image workflows.
Do not send confidential images unless RunComfy processing is approved.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps agents use Flux 1 Kontext Pro on RunComfy for precise single-image edits.

faq.question: Does it generate images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for editing one existing source image.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: The workflow needs one prompt and one publicly fetchable image URL.

faq.question: Can it edit multiple images at once?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends another model for multi-image workflows.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI must be installed and authenticated before model runs.

faq.question: Is private image data sent to a third party?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and image URLs are processed through RunComfy infrastructure.
